lead.en: A deliberate hold fills the button before it commits.
lead.zh: 按住时填充按钮，进度到达末端才提交。

rule.en: Hold Space or Enter for 1.2 seconds. Releasing early or leaving focus cancels. Restore resets the example.
rule.zh: 按住空格或 Enter 1.2 秒；提前松开或移走焦点会取消。点击还原可再次体验。

api.en: The default duration is 1200ms. Holding(bool) starts and stops hints; Confirmed fires once until reset.
api.zh: 默认 1200ms；Holding(bool) 驱动提示，Confirmed 只触发一次，reset 后可再次提交。

motion.en: The advancing fill is linear. Release reverses the fill on a spring; a quick re-press continues from the visible edge. Reduced motion preserves the hold duration.
motion.zh: 按住时进度匀速前进；松手后弹簧回退，快速重按从可见边缘继续。减少动效不缩短确认时间。

lead.en: Triage the inbox by swiping a message or choosing the same command from its menu.
lead.zh: 滑动消息，或从更多菜单中选择同一项操作来整理收件箱。

rule.en: Drag horizontally to reveal. Swipe farther to commit. Tab to More actions; use arrows and Enter. Undo restores the message in place.
rule.zh: 横拖展开操作，继续滑动可提交。Tab 聚焦更多菜单，方向键选择，Enter 执行；撤销后消息回到原位。

api.en: Supply stable row and action IDs. Removing actions collapse the row; keep_row actions leave it visible. Restore by row ID.
api.zh: 提供稳定的行和操作 ID。移除操作折叠该行；keep_row 保留它；按行 ID 还原。

motion.en: The front follows the drag. Release projects velocity into a resting stop or full commit; dismissal slides out and closes the gap.
motion.zh: 消息随指针横移。释放时根据距离和速度停靠或提交；移除时滑出，后续消息合拢。

lead.en: Add a reaction to a release note, change your vote, or pick another symbol.
lead.zh: 为发布说明添加回应，再次点击可撤回，也可以从选择器添加其他回应。

rule.en: Enter or Space toggles a count. From Add reaction, use arrows, Home or End; Enter chooses and Escape returns to the add button.
rule.zh: Enter 或空格切换回应。展开添加面板后，方向键或 Home、End 定位，Enter 选择，Esc 回到添加按钮。

api.en: Supply picker options and initial counts. ReactionChanged supplies the changed ID, count and personal selection.
api.zh: 提供可选项和初始计数。ReactionChanged 返回改变项的 ID、计数及个人选中状态。

motion.en: Digits roll up or down with the count. New pills expand, and the picker highlight follows its active option. A thin ring marks your own reactions. The moving highlight only indicates the current option; its caption has a check when you have already reacted.
motion.zh: 数字随增减上下滚动。新回应展开，选择器高亮跟随当前项。 细框标记你已添加的回应；移动的底色只标记当前项。当前项已选时，名称前显示勾。

lead.en: Keep a short list of project commands beside a labelled trigger.
lead.zh: 在按钮旁展开一组项目命令。

rule.en: Enter, Space or Down opens. Arrows wrap through enabled commands; Home, End and initial letters navigate. Escape returns focus.
rule.zh: Enter、空格或下方向键展开。方向键循环选择可用项；Home、End 或首字母定位。Esc 关闭并返回焦点。

api.en: Construct with a label and MenuItem list; subscribe to MenuSelection for the stable command ID.
api.zh: 使用标签和 MenuItem 列表构造，订阅 MenuSelection 接收稳定的命令 ID。

motion.en: A short stagger reveals the rows. One highlight glides between pointer targets and lands directly on keyboard targets.
motion.zh: 各行依次显现；鼠标移动时共享高亮滑动，键盘选择时直接定位。

lead.en: Right-click a project to open its commands at the pointer, or tap the project to open below it.
lead.zh: 右键在指针位置打开项目菜单，也可以轻点项目在下方展开。

rule.en: Right-click, tap, or press Shift+F10 on the target. Use arrows, Home and End to navigate; Enter selects, Escape dismisses.
rule.zh: 右键、轻点或在目标上按 Shift+F10 打开；方向键、Home、End 定位，Enter 选择，Esc 关闭。

api.en: Provide a target renderer and MenuItem list. Pointer placement and keyboard navigation share the same selection event.
api.zh: 提供目标绘制函数和 MenuItem 列表。指针、键盘激活都发送同一选择事件。

motion.en: The panel opens at the pointer and stays inside the viewport. Destructive commands retain a distinct highlight.
motion.zh: 面板从指针处展开，保持在视口内；危险命令拥有独立的高亮颜色。

lead.en: An account entry point with destinations, a theme preference and asynchronous sign-out.
lead.zh: 从头像进入账户菜单，打开个人资料、选择主题或退出登录。

rule.en: Enter opens the account menu. Up and Down move between rows; Left and Right change the active preference without closing. Escape dismisses.
rule.zh: Enter 打开账户菜单。上下键切换行；左右键更改当前偏好且保持菜单打开。Esc 关闭。

api.en: Handle Navigate, Appearance, Presence and SignOut in the host. After sign-out resolves call finish_sign_out; false leaves the menu ready to retry.
api.zh: 由宿主处理导航、主题、状态和退出请求。退出请求结束后调用 finish_sign_out，传 false 保留菜单供重试。

motion.en: The account panel opens from the avatar. On small screens the same commands rise in a bottom sheet.
motion.zh: 账户面板从头像处展开；小屏下同一组命令从底部升起。
